body.name: \((\Omega_j,\Sigma_h,\Sigma_g)\)
body.construction: For a normalized allocation \(\rho\in\Delta_J^{\mathbb Q}\) with \(\rho_j>0\) for every declared row, and for \(z_\ell,z_{\ell'}\in\mathcal T\), set \((\Omega_j)_{\ell\ell'}=H_j(z_\ell\odot z_{\ell'})-H_j(z_\ell)H_j(z_{\ell'})\), \(\Sigma_h=\operatorname{blockdiag}(\Omega_j/\rho_j)_{j=1}^{J}\), \(A_{\mathcal T}=M^{+}\otimes I_L\), \(g=\exp(A_{\mathcal T}\log h)\), and \(\Sigma_g=D_gA_{\mathcal T}D_h^{-1}\Sigma_hD_h^{-1}A_{\mathcal T}^{\mathsf T}D_g\), where \(D_h=\operatorname{diag}(h)\) and \(D_g=\operatorname{diag}(g)\).
